description.narrative: General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2014Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: The intended outcome primarily consists in ensuring the public servants in the state bureaucracy to provide services in an efficient, effective, transparent and non-discriminatory manner. In that respect, the two objectives for 2014 were: i) to achieve more transparency in public management and acts, and ii) to improve public services to the citizens. As to i) more than 173 000 laws, supreme decrees and other Bolivian regulations were digitalized and are available for the population through Internet. As to ii) The Bolivian Service for Personal Identification (SEGIP) initiated its services in July 2011 and until 2014, it has issued more than 283 050 ID documents following high standards of quality and security.
